svg.title: Spead AI Pro for WIKA: before and after
svg.desc: Before: Read the whole package to fill each review item. After: Spead drafts every item with a quote and a clause reference. Before: Trust or re-check every quote by hand. After: Each quote gets a status; only verified quotes are shown as verified. Before: Track general versus particular conditions mentally. After: The reader splits files into clauses and labels the agreement and appendix letters. Before: Ask a colleague where a clause is. After: Ask the package and open the cited page. Before: Shared folders with unclear access. After: Labels and confidentiality decide what each person's assistant can read. Before: Letters retyped on old letterheads. After: Company templates with locked letterhead, numbering and signing route.
